concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-verification-requirements-reference-additional-products]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured FATCA/CRS, industry-code and SOF information guide for Business accounts (SOF also Issuing), with US exception, approval gates and field-path inconsistency; not KYC approval proof.
warnings: SOF prose uses `sourceOfFunds.adyenProcessedFunds` but the first table row uses `businessLines.adyenProcessedFunds`; inspect the applicable API version/schema.
FATCA/CRS exception is specifically US-based legal entities applying for US business bank accounts; the tax/verification guidance is dated.
Some industries require pre-onboarding approval, and new industries outside a prior approval process require contacting Adyen/Support.
